_enabled: The operator enables the experiment. Unless this is the JSON value true, every mr-tester-ab command prints AB-SKIP disabled and mr-spawn renders the brief without the experiment's sentence.
_cache_root: Shadow testers write their tests under cache_root. The pilot confirms a tester subagent can write there in a headless session: one that cannot falls back to the builder's worktree, and `collect` then marks it contaminated and lists the paths to remove.
_eligibility: A slice is in the experiment when it is listed in required_slices or starts with a prefix, and is not in exclude_slices. List design, refactor and doc-only slices of those prefixes in exclude_slices: they have no tester.
_reserve: USD by model. The cap counts every planned arm at its reserve until its run has a price: a slice planned and not collected, a shadow that failed, a transcript that could not be priced. Five arms reserve 39; the measured mean of five runs is 24 and one opus run reached 39.
_escapes: escapes_in_session stays false until a pilot shows five suites replay at one snapshot inside escapes_budget_s, setup included; `escapes` then only records the snapshot and failing shadow tests are judged at the close. The budget stays under 120 s: `escapes` runs in the builder's foreground Bash call, which the Bash tool stops at that default.
_close: finalize closes the experiment when every slice in required_slices is finalized and merged with no planned slice left unfinalized, when max_scored_slices slices are scored, when the cap is reached, or when the default branch has commits on loop_active_days distinct days since the first scored slice. An empty required_slices never closes it.
_runners: Each arm's test files are overlaid on a snapshot in <cache_root>/scratch and run by the first runner whose match fits. {files} expands to the files, {packages} to a -p pair per cargo package they belong to, {names} to their test names as a regex alternation, {scope} to the runner's `scopes` expression of each file joined by ` | ` ({stem} is the file's name without its extension: an integration test is its own binary, any other Rust test file is a module), {junit} to the report path, {tool} to this directory. `junit` names a report the runner writes itself, relative to the scratch directory: nextest writes under the workspace's own target/ whatever CARGO_TARGET_DIR says. `probe` must exit 0 before the runner is used, and `no_tests_rc` is its exit code when the build held none of the tests asked for (a Rust file no `mod` line names): those tests are not-run, not no-compile. A file no runner fits (Playwright specs) is recorded not-run.
_runner_env: Every replay and seeded-defect command runs with runner_env set (a quarter of this machine's 32 cores: other slices build and run time-bounded gates beside it) and with the runner_path directories that exist ahead of PATH (the game's pinned toolchain: the caller's PATH may resolve another node).
_mutants: The seeded-defect measure, reported beside confirmed findings and never a gate: on a slice whose merged diff changes a matching file, the changed lines are mutated once per arm with only that arm's tests that pass at merge deciding what is caught: `runner` names the runner whose scopes keep the run to the arm's own files, so a test of the same name in the gating suite kills nothing for the arm. One wall budget covers the slice.
_areas: The area of a slice is the one pattern its merged diff matches, mixed when it matches both, other when neither.
_prices: USD, measured 24 Oct - 12 Nov 2026 unless noted. lens_caught: mean in-session fix cycle after a lens batch (8.74, n=27) less the median closeout baseline (0.95, n=44); lens_caught_low: the median fix cycle (6.30) less the same baseline. post_merge: median ci-fix slice (n=9), the price of an escape, base or spec miss in the central scenario. escape_high: median residual-fix slice, Aug-Oct ledger (n=91, cost columns unreliable). spec_high: median relaunched slice after a park (n=18). fp: mean post-lens tester re-invocation (n=29), also the price of a brittle break; fp_low: its median. flake: median ci-fix slice. Scenarios: low prices every miss at lens_caught_low and a false positive at fp_low; central prices a lens-caught miss at lens_caught and any other at post_merge; high prices escape and base misses at escape_high and spec misses at spec_high.
